text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The day of the JBC Classic—Hokko Tarumae 
feels wary of Wonder Acute's colossal, 
towering presence."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute tells Hokko Tarumae that she 
has trained beyond her limits just to 
defeat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae couldn't help but shiver 
with excitement at the thought of 
competing against Wonder Acute. The 
showdown between the two was about to 
begin—!
